description: This Java source file defines the TouchPaint class, an Android activity that implements a touch-based painting application. It includes an inner class PaintView which handles drawing, touch and input events, and rendering logic for user interaction with the canvas.

classes.name: TouchPaint
classes.description: Main Android activity class that initializes the painting view, manages menu options, and handles the fading effect via a handler.

classes.name: TouchPaint.PaintView
classes.description: Custom View class that implements the drawing surface, handles input events (touch, hover, trackball), and rendering of paint strokes, splats, and fading effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the painting view, restores saved state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu for clearing and toggling fading effects.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, updates checked state for fading toggle.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections: clearing the canvas, toggling fading.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes fading if enabled when activity comes to foreground.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves fading state and color index.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops fading effects when activity is paused.

methods.name: startFading
methods.description: Starts the fading pulse, removes previous messages.

methods.name: scheduleFade
methods.description: Schedules the next fade message with delay.
